interface.title: BioGenius: End-to-End Differential Expression Analysis (BioGenius: RNA-Seq)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and interpretation: statistical testing of a count matrix you already have, picking hits, and exporting results
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload an RNA-seq count matrix and sample metadata (or load a built-in synthetic cancer dataset), choose a target and a reference group, run PyDESeq2, then explore and export the differentially expressed genes on a volcano plot whose thresholds you can adjust.

data.note: First run used the uploaded sample_counts.csv (1000 genes) and sample_meta.csv (one 'Condition' column with Cancer and Normal). Later the built-in 'Load Sample Cancer Data' button was used with both uploads removed. Both give the same result: BRCA1 up (log2FC 2.13, -log10 padj 6.03) and TP53 down (log2FC -2.14, -log10 padj 4.28) at the default thresholds of |log2FC| ≥ 1 and padj ≤ 0.05. Two files were downloaded: deseq2_results.csv (Gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj, -log10(padj), Status) and plot-image.png.

features.name: Contrast picker with run button
features.general: Pick the annotation column that defines the groups, then the test group and the reference group (filled in from that column), and run the statistical model; swap the two to flip the comparison. The plot's group labels follow the selections immediately, so until you re-run, an old result can carry the new group names
features.specific: Comparison Column, Target Condition and Reference Condition selects, then 🚀 Run Analysis (PyDESeq2), which shows a spinner and then 'Analysis completed successfully!'. Legend labels (e.g. 'Upregulated (Normal)') follow the selects before re-running, so the previous result can show the new group names (screens/040.webp)
steps: choose the Comparison Column
choose the Target Condition
choose the Reference Condition
press Run Analysis and wait for the success message (re-run after changing groups; the legend relabels before the run)
optionally swap Target and Reference and run again

features.specific: Log2 Fold Change Threshold slider (0–3) and Adjusted P-Value Threshold field (step 0.01) drive the Upregulated/Downregulated metrics, the point colours and the dashed lines at ±log2FC and -log10(padj)

type a padj cutoff or press −/+
